scope: Fresh screenshots of the local Toon Pro 0.76 build. A chapter image is shared by its feature entries; context images do not claim to show every feature's individual controls.

product-and-status.label: Workspace context: the native drawing editor with a synthetic sample drawing.

local-setup.label: Startup context: Projects after launching the app. The cover illustration is imported sample artwork.

first-drawing.label: Canvas setup: size presets, exact dimensions, background and live preview before creating a drawing.

projects-and-assets.label: Project Assets: folders, tags and an image inspector. The illustration was imported, not created in Toon Pro.

workspace-and-navigation.label: Workspace context: independent document tabs and a rotated working view in a synthetic fixture.

brush-basics.label: Workspace context: brush previews and quick Size, Opacity, Flow, Hardness and Smoothing controls.

brush-dynamics.label: Related brush controls: Shape dynamics with a pen-pressure response graph and curve presets.

brush-library.label: Workspace context: Tools lists named brush presets and proportional previews beside the canvas.

stamp-brushes.label: Related brush controls: General settings. Stamp-specific creation and placement steps are described in the guide.

connected-brushes-and-tones.label: Related brush controls: the advanced settings dialog. Connected modes and surface patterns use their own categories.

stabilization-and-shapes.label: Workspace context: direct Smooth/Strong tabs, Smoothing strength and the hold-to-shape action in Properties.

colors-and-gradients.label: Workspace context: the inline Colors picker and saved swatches are visible at the upper right.

vector-drawing.label: Related vector controls: Path Edit with a source path selected and width, opacity and color settings.

fills-and-reference-layers.label: Fill controls: marked reference boundaries, Point/Enclose modes, tolerance, gap closing and expansion.

selections-and-clipboard.label: Related selection controls: selection modes and inspector settings used by constrained artwork edits.

transforms.label: Related transform example: the pin-based Puppet Warp preview. Other transform modes are documented in the guide.

puppet-warp.label: Puppet Warp: a synthetic raster fixture with a visible mesh, editable pins, density and Apply/Cancel.

layers-and-compositing.label: Related layer controls: blend mode, opacity, locks, visibility, folders and layer actions.

masks-and-effects.label: Related Effects controls: the live Outline category. Mask, Blur, Shadow, Glow and Color have separate tabs.

perspective-guides.label: Guide inspector: multiple assistants with independent visibility, handle locks, snapping and density.

perspective-detection.label: Perspective detection: review a synthetic one-point source, detected directions and an editable guide proposal.

line-and-tone-conversion.label: Line conversion: raster cel-shading preview from an imported illustration. The source artwork was not created in Toon Pro.

references-and-model-sheets.label: Workspace context: References is available beside Colors and Navigator; model-sheet workflows are described in the guide.

character-color-models.label: Workspace context for character reference work. The visible global Colors picker is separate from character-role palettes.

cel-paint-and-shading.label: Workspace context: separate ink and color layers in a synthetic drawing used to explain paint and shading workflows.

light-table.label: Workspace context for tracing and reference work. Light Table snapshot controls are documented in the guide.

reference-3d.label: Native 3D reference layer: Seed-san and a dog in the drawing canvas, with the model library and Draw above action.

save-recovery-and-backup.label: Document context: independent editor tabs, whose artwork saves and recovery revisions are managed separately.

history-and-auto-actions.label: Workspace context: independent drawing tabs. History and Auto Actions are separate optional docks.

frame-by-frame-animation.label: Animation context: a single-shot document with its drawing track, timeline and current drawing layer.

keyframes-and-cameras.label: Timeline context for shot animation. Property, effect and camera controls are explained in the guide.

symbols-and-lip-sync.label: Timeline context for reusable drawings and timed poses. The screenshot shows a basic drawing track.

audio-and-export.label: Shot-editor context for sound and output workflows. Audio and export dialogs are described in the guide.

inbetweens.label: Timeline context: the in-betweens action belongs to drawing-cel workflows and requires an optional local runtime.

shortcuts-and-troubleshooting.label: Workspace context: tools, property controls and the status bar used to diagnose canvas restrictions.

gallery.description: Actual Shape dynamics controls with a pen-pressure response graph. This related panel illustrates native brush tuning.

gallery.title: Keep the line editable

gallery.title: Pin it. Bend it. Keep the source.
gallery.description: A raster test fixture deformed by editable Puppet Warp pins, with mesh density and explicit Apply/Cancel.

gallery.title: Find another angle
gallery.description: Editable Seed-san and dog models in a native 3D reference layer, ready for the Draw above workflow.

gallery.title: Review the vanishing point
gallery.description: A synthetic source supplies straight-edge evidence for a local, editable perspective proposal before Add guides.

gallery.title: Let the ink set the boundaries
gallery.description: The real Fill inspector shows marked reference sampling, Point/Enclose, gap closing and signed expansion.

gallery.title: An image, a different line of thought
gallery.description: Line and cel-shading conversion preview from imported sample artwork. The source illustration was not created in Toon Pro.

gallery.title: Keep your materials together
gallery.description: The project-owned Assets view with filters, tags and an image inspector. The illustrated reference was imported.

gallery.title: When a drawing needs a little time
gallery.description: An independent single-shot animation document with an existing drawing track and timeline; sample state from a real UI test.
